confirmation.all20_primary_denominator_rule: After the >=15/20 Stage1+Stage2 qualification gate passes, all 20 frozen confirmation indices remain in both primary sign-test denominators and the full-population mean-effect lower-bound denominators. For each Stage2-qualified nonzero-unique family, use the observed paired LCA2 contrasts d_no_patch=ACTIVE_LCA2-NO_PATCH_LCA2 and d_specificity=ACTIVE_LCA2-max_specificity_LCA2. For a Stage2-unqualified family, no causal rollout is imputed as observed; instead assign the mathematically conservative lower bound -1.0 to EACH LCA2 contrast for the all20 mean-effect calculation, because LCA2 is in {0,0.5,1} and any paired difference is bounded below by -1. The sign contribution is non-positive. For a zero-unique qualified family, the injected vector is exact zero and it cannot provide positive causal evidence: use min(observed d_no_patch,0) and min(observed d_specificity,0) in the all20 lower-bound means and count both signs non-positive. Thus lower_bound_mean_d_no_patch=sum(20 conservative family contributions)/20 and lower_bound_mean_d_specificity likewise. No deletion/replacement. This rule is deliberately stricter than zero imputation and supports only a lower-bound full-population effect claim.

development.common_denominator_rule: Freeze one common development denominator E_common BEFORE any layer/alpha outcome evaluation. First run the unchanged Stage1 gate on all fixed development indices0..31. For every Stage1-eligible family, construct the frozen source/projection/control material independently at BOTH candidate layers14 and21 using the same pre-outcome rules. A family enters E_common iff it is Stage2-constructible at every candidate layer: projection succeeds, zero-unique is allowed as exact-zero intervention, and whenever ||r_unique||>1e-8 every required matched source-control vector is nonzero and norm-matchable at both layers. E_common is the sorted intersection of the two layer-constructible index sets, frozen once before the causal grid. Require |E_common|>=24/32; otherwise stop INCONCLUSIVE_PLANUNIQUE_COMMON_DENOMINATOR_CONSTRUCTIBILITY with no grid and no confirmation. Every one of the 8 layer×alpha grid points MUST contain exactly E_common, and all medians, positive fractions, MSA2 competence means and selection tie-break statistics use exactly that same indexed denominator. After E_common freeze, any missing/failed family at any grid point is TECHNICAL_INVALID for the development execution; it may not be dropped, replaced, or converted into a layer-specific denominator. Operational ordering is fail-closed and non-circular: first freeze E_stage1 from all32 under unchanged Stage1 rules; then choose every unrelated-plan donor deterministically from E_stage1 using the inherited next-different-family rule, independent of later Stage2/common-denominator membership; then construct both candidate layers and freeze E_common.
